snippet.title: Mancalero | Official Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Mancalero is a marble strategy roguelike inspired by Mancala.

Sow marbles across a tabletop board, build scoring synergies with special marbles and Blessings, outsmart rule-changing bosses, and push every run toward impossible scores.

Free demo available September 15, 2026 on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4811700/Mancalero/

Press kit:
https://cerlus.github.io/mancalero-press-media-hub/#creators

Discord:
https://discord.gg/2dekXMnvD

Developed by ArchiusDev.

#Mancalero #Roguelike #IndieGame #SteamDemo #StrategyGame
